steps.description: LAC-2087: clean smoke reproduces daemon acquire then operator hold without a next acquire, while the watcher PID remains live. It also verifies that a concrete coexistence operation retains its waiter across a soft caller deadline and removes it on terminal/stacked-base exits before closure dispatch or errors, while eventual eligible contention retains it. Competing posted-review polls at the same or moved head cannot enter until the operation and handler settle; unrelated PRs progress, and settlement admits the next poll. Late errors are logged without a test-owned rejection handler. Missing candidate bases use the stored review base for cleanup. It verifies obsolete daemon waiter removal, preservation and arrival order of another live daemon, ordinary FIFO order and following closer acquisition without expiry or bypass. LEASEFAIR-04: daemon reservations last twice the configured watcher poll interval, load-scaled once with a timer-safe ceiling. Ineligibility, head movement and merge completion remove them immediately; confirmed dead same-host watchers are pruned and uncertain identities expire. Holder release wakes the first daemon PR at its reserved head through the existing per-head cap. The clean offline smoke verifies retention at 299 seconds and one exact-head release wake. HAMATTEST-02 verifies that a head-bound shared rereview decision takes ownership before historical hammer routing, including at the review ceiling, while carried clean verdicts reach ordinary merge eligibility. LEASEFAIR-03 verifies the per-base history records closer/daemon grants and releases, including the retry hold. LEASEFAIR-02 verifies the closer retry retains its lease across a synthetic CI wait after FIFO service; another daemon cannot overtake it. LAC-2097 clean smoke drains two queued validated PRs across unrelated base advances with unchanged source heads, no CI restarts, preserved author/HAM content and empty holder/waiters. Focused rendered-shell fixtures in test/hammer-self-rebase.test.mjs cover strict versus non-strict touching/disjoint advances, asynchronous acknowledgements, exhausted reacquisition without source mutation, fresh exact-head range evidence, one shared CI deadline including rebase time, and conflict/red/expiry release without live GitHub. LEASEFAIR-01 verifies daemon reservations cannot preempt a holder or overtake an earlier closer; both roles retain FIFO service. Synthetic broker receipt recovery survives a lost acquire response without a delivery row or run record; live processes renew, failed releases retain the journal, and confirmed drain retries release with a positive acknowledgement. ITP-11 also verifies two synthetic ready OS holders carry one canonical gemini-reviewer identity; independent pools cannot acquire a third lease, cleanup/drain failures retain the durable fence until readiness succeeds, an in-flight release retains its local receipt during concurrent readiness, a terminal pre-spawn record without a PGID allows re-admission, and failed release immediately isolates its drained holder and starts authenticated recovery. No credentials, live broker, enrollment or live provider calls. HAMATTEST-02 regression fixtures also execute the pushed-attestation CLI with conflicting ambient credentials, refuse a fallback push after known API publication, recover transient post-rebase snapshots, and verify failed/refused exact-head reviews accumulate idle time through bounded recovery and one exhaustion page. SDK 0.3.0 readDispatchStatus supplies producer terminal/succeeded meanings; targeted hq-dispatch-status-json fixtures exercise every public canonical serializer example and negative explicit-false/unknown/alias mutations through runtime, remediation and merge-agent boundaries. The clean smoke also verifies SDK explicit false precedence, wire-only terminal meanings and rejected launch-success aliases. The clean smoke also projects wire-only success/failure and explicit false terminal events through the shared status parser. Targeted closer, merge-agent and hq-dispatch-status-json regressions cover stale active-worker recovery, final-cap reconciliation, uniform unverified success recording, wire-only bounded retry, cancel cleanup and normalized-event remediation settlement. LRQSTATUS-01 clean smoke verifies parked-to-running ownership fences for repeated dispatch and inline daemon merge, restored running capacity accounting, then confirmed terminal release. The full parked/resumed vocabulary, capacity, retry descendants and secondary-probe persistence are covered offline by targeted launch-request-status and ama-closer-dispatch-priority tests; no live decision mutation is required. MERGESIGNAL-01 targeted ama-closer-dispatch-priority fixtures verify that advanced-head dispatch ignores obsolete reviewed-head completion signals, retains target hammer ownership without successful lease settlement, and probes/logs once. Existing sandbox smoke promises are unchanged. HAMATTEST-03 clean smoke selects shared exact-head review after the historical review ceiling and executes production coexistence through a bounded wait: live or uncertain hammer ownership queues no review and retains the wait owner, confirmed absence queues within the same poll and promotes the owner to review, and repeated observations reserve only one request. After deployment, SRE observes the next hammer that publishes and stops without merging: merge or exact-head review must follow within one poll without manual rescue. Focused offline merge-lease/daemon-merge regressions verify FIFO across roles, failed-holder tail re-entry, per-head exponential backoff, repeated-failure parking, draft withdrawal, dead watcher pruning and bounded closer polling. The clean lease scenario verifies earlier closer service before a later daemon and retains holder fences. Planned CI-wait yields and retryable aborts reset consecutive failure counting without clearing an existing park; yields retain gate charges and abort refunds persist atomically with release identity. Non-permanent daemon failures yield. Only daemon reservations requeue; CLI processes return with fresh invocation IDs. Grants alone preserve failure evidence. Repeated-failure parks use the existing audit, closing-status comment and page path. HAMLEASE-01 progress gaps are bounded by 40 seconds (25 seconds plus the fixed 15-second polling ceiling), excluding synchronous I/O. The clean lease scenario also verifies six same-head planned yields and transient aborts without parking, then same-head reacquisition.

LVR-02 verifies launch-bound early failure audits and no_work_done classification with existing retry policy. NXA-07 also verifies exact-head validated terminal HAM proof crossing retry selection into pending, failed or green CI gates; mismatched proof retains hammer retry ownership. NXA-07 verifies one shared decision projection across the seven synthetic incident families and combined unknown/stop evidence. Retains physical lease/retry/terminal settlement, final-push handoff, daemon and closeout contracts. Live acceptance for each earlier caller remains pending operator/SRE evidence; source rollback uses 4d06237c. NXA-06 verifies changed daemon CI evidence, operator-approved same-head daemon retry exhaustion selecting R08 hammer repair, live hammer ownership and unconfirmed merge receipt recovery through the shared decision. Focused daemon-route-disagreement fixtures return nextActionShared and verify returned liveGate facts survive adoption. The first live daemon candidate and first decline-routed hammer remain separate pending operator/SRE observation; no worker live operation. NXA-05 verifies that drain/capacity retain selected hammer intent and deadline, while deterministic automatic stops return the same closure-recovery generation reported by their page. Focused closer-next-action and posted-review-row fixtures cover carried clean verdicts at the ceiling and explicit operator holds overriding automated or drain snapshots. NXA-04 verifies one remediation closeout successor through pending, green and red CI with an anchored deadline and unchanged round count, plus durable re-review admission intent for pending non-final closeout. NXA-03 verifies shared immutable decision wake routing, live-owner suppression and one wake per reconciled no-merge attempt at the same head; the next shadow consumer receives the same decision. No merge permission is granted. REMEDBRANCH-01 verifies unresolved remediation head metadata holds pending without a worker or round charge and recovery carries the resolved branch; three failed lookups stop without a worker or round charge, and confirmed publication leaves the review gate pending; settled clean reviews bypass branch reads and legacy holds, and unchanged workspace HEADs reject publication debt inferred from reply hashes. HAMNOREREVIEW-01 verifies the retired handoff helper requests no review, releases its dispatch lease for hammer retry, and the full reviewed-to-built range passes the real range and eligibility predicates before a disposable Git merge. BRANCHPROBE-01 verifies null head metadata uses Git confirmation, unknown reads defer without consuming budget, and recovery dispatches; unidentified forks stop for operator inspection after six hours without charging launch budget or continuing same-head probes. Terminal scratch cleanup preserves a draining recorded process and removes its private pytest tree after exit; aged terminal cwd-timeout recovery; oldest-first scratch cursor resumes across passes and restarts with independent ledger timeouts; TERMLEASE-01 same-pass terminal superseded/failed-without-merge/deferred lease reclaim with finished launches and exclusive reacquisition; CLOSERINTENT-01 smoke verifies foreign receipt refusal settles no-dispatch, supersedes the pending lease, refunds the attempt and allows next-poll admission; terminal no-merge lease/capacity release and wake re-arm; armed auto-merge retains ownership inside the 30-minute lease window and releases at expiry; unreadable fresh launches reserve capacity.

HAMREDCI-01: shared failed-CI repair admission works with and without findings, including final-round blocking findings; merge permission still requires all existing findings, proof, CI and structural gates. HAMPROVCI-01 verifies failed-CI admission and direct round requeue preserve a completed comment-only final handoff and its strict hammer starting-base edge, even at the round cap; suppression without the canonical finalRound marker retains ordinary requeue handling. LEASELIVE-01: offline handoff smoke retains a 45-minute running closer lease, releases a terminal launch and exercises the execution-ceiling fallback without live state. LEASEDEADPID-01: dead pending watcher ownership releases final comment findings to hammer without lease writes; live pending ownership waits; foreign-host pending ownership expires by age without local PID probes using a numeric epoch-millisecond clock. CI-repair wake and ownership admit terminal failed conclusions on a stale reviewed head; an empty same-head verdict does not establish repair ownership; LAC-2081 verifies later refusals preserve earlier intent/lease/prompt evidence; keyed native reconciliation recovers receipts or settles proven prepared no-submission, while unknown reaches inspection without canceling ownership. LEGACYINTENT-01 verifies legacy unreadable ledger evidence holds and successful empty ticket/time evidence settles no-dispatch with a deferred lease. CLOSERGATE-01 verifies one durable inspection page and no fleet launch admission or capacity for unresolved intents, plus authoritative terminal PR intent retirement without paging, immediate dispatch refusal on newly discovered terminal state, bounded GitHub retries and exact-key local receipt recovery during GitHub outages. CLOSERINTENT-01 unit fixtures verify same/moved-head retry-probe refusal releases the new lease and preserves predecessor evidence with bounded charging, expired keyed empty-key settlement and pre-deadline holds with query evidence; scaled timeout, retry, identity refusal, absent/null repository compatibility for exact-key recovery and live retries, and audited keyed operator cases are offline unit fixtures. Deterministic SIGKILL, replacement, lock and audited operator fixtures remain in the offline unit suite. CEILINGPUSH-01 also verifies green moved-head ceiling wake admission independent of legacy exhaustion reason/snapshot and idempotent routing with the original reviewed head.

WATCHERTIMER-01 verifies a 20-repo poll at 5x load uses the already-scaled reviewer budget under a fixed 24-hour ceiling; milliseconds and converted seconds stay below Node's timer maximum even with Infinity policy caps. LOADAR-01 scales nominal operational bounds with the shared load-aware helper, including closure env overrides; confirmed live launches report still running at the effective bound without changing ownership or receipts. HAMCLOSEWAIT-01 verifies an existing final-round wait advances to a retained launch timestamp: no page at twenty minutes, exhaustion without progress after thirty; repeated future-dated timestamps cannot postpone a stall page. HAMCLOSEWAIT-02 verifies a running background launch borrows its already-sized execution window, successful settlement persists the launch timestamp across SQLite reopen, refusal restores original debt, and either path pages only once. Packaging stops retain unchanged deterministic refusals and fence ownerless recovery even with packaging-only audit history, without another page; changed inputs release persisted refusals. Production preflight retires legacy holds without audit history, and mixed transient predicates prevent pure infrastructure classification. Includes distinct fleet-stop-active and fleet-stop-merge-kill reasons, uncached ledger-independent refusal and matching file removal using disposable roots; activation also requires the registered watcher to adopt the reader and old hammers to drain.
